question: What are the course fees and EMI payment options at Nova Skills?
answer: Nova Skills offers transparent fee structures ranging from ₹15,000 for Certification Courses up to ₹60,000 for 12-month Career Programs. We offer flexible No-Cost EMI options (3, 6, 9, or 12 months) with 0% interest to ensure affordable learning for all students.

question: Does Nova Skills provide placement assistance?
answer: Yes! All 6-month and 12-month programs at Nova Skills include 100% Dedicated Placement Assistance. Our active Placement Cell provides resume building, LinkedIn profile optimization, 1-on-1 mock interviews, and direct interview scheduling with over 150+ corporate hiring partners.

question: Are classes available online or offline?
answer: Both! Students can choose between Live Online Classes (interactive live sessions led by expert instructors with real-time Q&A) or Classroom Training at our state-of-the-art campus.

question: Will I receive a recognized certificate upon completion?
answer: Yes. Upon successful completion of your course and live capstone projects, you will receive an ISO 9001:2015 recognized Nova Skills Certificate. In addition, digital marketing students earn industry certifications from Google, Meta, and HubSpot.

question: What is the eligibility criteria for joining Nova Skills courses?
answer: Our courses are designed for beginners as well as professionals. Students who have cleared 10th/12th, ongoing college undergraduates, graduates (B.Com, BCA, B.Tech, BBA, BA), and working professionals looking for a career upgrade are eligible to apply.
